_comment: Generic STEP/DIR/EN carrier for Glasgow rev C3.
This file is intended to be loaded by the stepper applet config path.
Pins are expressed as Glasgow port pin numbers, with optional inversion.
The FPGA only generates STEP/DIR/EN. Current limit, microstep mode,
and motor selection are set on the external driver module.

motorProfiles.name: NEMA17_balanced
notes: Typical 1.8 degree bipolar stepper on an A4988/DRV8825/TMC2209-class driver.
Use moderate pulse rate and set the driver current limit to the motor's rated phase current.

motorProfiles.name: NEMA23_high_torque
notes: Higher inductance motor that usually needs a larger supply voltage and slower step rate.
Increase the driver current limit only within the motor datasheet rating.

motorProfiles.name: low_inductance_precision
notes: Use when the mechanical system can tolerate faster acceleration and shorter periods.
Verify that the driver still satisfies the minimum STEP high time.
